# Bodiatrade Co., Ltd.

> Cambodia business consulting and agricultural food import/export trade. Building bridges between strategy and execution across Southeast Asia.

Bodiatrade helps foreign investors and local businesses navigate Cambodia's regulatory environment and agricultural trade landscape. Core services include company registration, tax compliance, labor law compliance, and agricultural import/export facilitation.

## Services

- [Company Registration in Cambodia](https://www.hanukreajea.com/services-company-registration.html): Ministry of Commerce filings, tax ID, business licenses, Social Security Fund enrollment.
- [Business Consulting](https://www.hanukreajea.com/services-consulting.html): Regulatory compliance, market entry strategy, legal documentation for Cambodia and Southeast Asia.
- [Tax Compliance](https://www.hanukreajea.com/services-tax-compliance.html): VAT returns, corporate income tax, withholding tax, GDT filings, and tax audit support.
- [Labor Law Compliance](https://www.hanukreajea.com/services-labor-law.html): Employment contracts, NSSF registration, payroll compliance, HR policy setup, labor dispute support.
- [Agricultural Trade Solutions](https://www.hanukreajea.com/services-trade.html): Import/export facilitation, CAMCONTROL certification, quality assurance, supply chain management.
